Intro
Red White and Clix is an annual Heroclix tournament and fundraiser founded by disabled veteran Wesley Robertson. Now in its third year, the event brings players together for competitive play, community, and support of veteran nonprofit organizations.

Red, White, and Clix uses the platform Squarespace for our website. I have neither the time nor the skills to maintain our site and give it the updates it needs. I am asking for a volunteer to be our website person. It won't require a large investment of time. Just periodic updates, once we get it set up the way it needs to be. If you have squareapace experience or just have a desire to help in this way, please reach out. Thank you.
